'''Sunniva Siem''' (born 1969){{r|solen}} is a Norwegian experimental [[nuclear physics|nuclear physicist]], a professor of nuclear and energy physics at the [[University of Oslo]],{{r|uio}} and the director of the Norwegian Nuclear Research Centre.{{r|nnrc}}

She has served as president of the [[Norwegian Physical Society]], and was elected to the [[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]] in 2017.{{r|dnva}}
